templates.name: Manual classifier
templates.description: Paste/submit one structured event and classify it.

worker.role: Classify one event and decide what to do with it.

experiment.objective: Determine whether the input matters and how it should be routed.
experiment.task_prompt: Classify the supplied event. Separate evidence from inference. Return what changed, relevance, route, and unresolved questions.

llm.prompt: Explain the event only when bounded classification is insufficient. Use evidence only.

templates.name: Browser DOM reader
templates.description: Use structured browser text first; OCR stays off.

worker.description: Classify and extract from browser DOM/accessibility text.
worker.role: Read a page structurally and decide whether deeper interpretation is needed.

experiment.objective: Extract useful evidence from a web page without using OCR when the DOM already contains the text.
experiment.task_prompt: Read the page evidence. Identify the requested facts, preserve source/provenance, and decide whether the page needs deeper semantic analysis.
experiment.eval_metric: field accuracy + source fidelity + escalation precision

llm.prompt: Use the extracted DOM/accessibility evidence to answer the experiment question. Do not invent content that is not present.

templates.name: Browser visual/OCR reader
templates.description: For canvas, screenshots, image-only text, or visual state.

worker.role: Interpret information that is not available in structured page text.

experiment.objective: Recover useful visual evidence from screenshot/canvas/image content and decide whether LLM interpretation is required.
experiment.task_prompt: Use OCR/visual extraction only for information absent from structured page text. Preserve OCR uncertainty and source coordinates when available.
experiment.eval_metric: OCR field accuracy + visual classification + escalation precision
experiment.notes: This is intentionally separate from DOM browsing.

llm.prompt: Interpret only the visual/OCR evidence supplied. Report uncertain text explicitly.

templates.name: Always-on stream watcher
templates.description: Daemon worker over one or more configured sources.

worker.description: Continuous classifier over real data sources.
worker.role: Track changes, regimes, anomalies, and relevance over time.

experiment.objective: Detect meaningful state changes in a continuous event stream.
experiment.task_prompt: Compare this event against the worker's recurrent state. Identify regime change, anomaly, novelty, and whether the event deserves deeper analysis.
experiment.eval_metric: precision/recall on labeled changes + latency + false positive rate

llm.prompt: Explain only high-value anomalies or unresolved transitions.

templates.name: Local files / chat memory
templates.description: Ingest selected local exports into structured memory.

worker.role: Turn local evidence into project/entity/state memory.

experiment.objective: Identify projects, entities, decisions, unresolved tasks, and state changes in local data.
experiment.task_prompt: Extract only evidence-supported project state, decisions, entities, links, and unresolved tasks. Preserve provenance to the local source.
experiment.eval_metric: entity precision + state-change accuracy + retrieval usefulness

llm.prompt: Extract project/entity/state information from the local evidence. Do not infer private facts beyond the supplied source.
